adjudicated.labeler: Claude (one labeller; not dual-labelled, so the corpus is not golden)

labelNotes: Pages 615-617 hold no operating supply-voltage range (Table 621 lists supply pins without values; '@ IOVDD=1.8V' etc. are conditions) and no supply current: IIOVDD_MAX / IIOVSS_MAX 50 mA are total IO current limits, not supply currents. Pin input leakage IIN 1 uA sits in the Maximum column (checked with pdftotext); it is printed twice, for digital IO (p616) and USB IO (p617), with the identical tuple, so it is one label citing p616. Abs max: only IOVDD 3.63 V; VPIN 'IOVDD + 0.5' is an expression and skipped. Pull-ups: GPIO RPU 50-80 kohm and USB RPU2 0.873-1.548 kohm; RPD (pull-down) excluded. 'RPU' alone is a substring of 'RPU2', so the RPU citation spans two cells to be unique.
